column2: 1. Start with A+ leads. Open the signal source and confirm the role/post is still live before sending a message.
2. Use the first-ranked person in Contacts. Personalize the supplied first message with one relevant proof point or case study.
3. Pitch a managed pilot or overflow pod — do not present yourself as a job applicant unless that is your intent.
4. Record activity in Lead Summary: Outreach Status, Owner, Last Contacted and Next Action.
5. Public contact data only. No guessed emails, private phone numbers or scraped personal data are included.

Important: a live hiring post is a high-intent signal, not proof that the organization will outsource. Verify live status, lead with a low-risk pilot, and use the evidence links before every outreach.
